_notes.pass_probability: Intentionally absent. No historical pass-rate data exists for this account yet. B4 _apply_risk_goal falls back to the conservative 0.85 Kelly multiplier for PASS_EVAL accounts without a computed probability. Once Pseudotrader accumulates ≥30 sessions of data, a rolling pass probability should be seeded here (see plan: post-Phase-8 + 30 days). Do NOT hardcode 0.5 — that would over-conserve before data exists.
_notes.evaluation_end_date: Intentionally null. Topstep 150K Combine STAGE_1 has time_limit_days=null (no fixed deadline per Topstep rules as of 2026-04). B4 _compute_tsm_cap falls back to tsm_budget_divisor_default (20 days) when evaluation_end_date is absent. This spreads the remaining MDD budget over a conservative 20-session window, which is appropriate for an open-ended combine.
_notes.max_daily_loss: Intentionally absent. The Topstep 150K Combine does not impose a separate daily loss limit (MLL) — only the trailing max drawdown limit of $4,500 applies. Setting a false max_daily_loss would incorrectly cap daily contract counts via the MLL gate in _compute_tsm_cap. B4 correctly uses max_by_mll=999 (no limit) when this field is absent.

topstep_params._c_history: Bumped c=0.5 -> c=1.0 on 2026-05-06 alongside per-session budget allocation. Original L_halt = 0.5 * 0.01 * 150000 = $750 was unworkably tight (any 4-ES-contract NY trade tripped L1 even on profitable days). With c=1.0 and equal-3-way per-session split, effective per-session L_halt = ~$500 each, giving each session room to run its locked strategy. See docs2/audits/2026-05-06_per_session_budget_design.md.
